title: Emmys 2026: red carpet looks and outfits at TV’s biggest night – in pictures
text:
Emmys 2026: red carpet looks and outfits at TV’s biggest night – in pictures
Zendaya, Nicole Kidman and Selena Gomez are among the stars at the 78th Primetime Emmys in Los Angeles, with actors from The Pitt, Pluribus, Hacks and Widow’s Bay walking the red (well, blue) carpet
This year’s Emmys host Mariska Hargitay – who has already won two awards of her own for documentary My Mom Jayne – elects for the Jessica Rabbit look in a glittering red sequinned gown.Photograph: Mark J Terrill/AP
Colman Domingo, nominated both for outstanding guest actor in a drama series for his role as Ali in Euphoria and for outstanding supporting actor in a comedy series for The Four Seasons, reminding nominees that formal menswear does not have to mean just a black tux, wearing a traditional jacket complete with frog buttons and a mandarin collar over cream silk pants.Photograph: Frederic J Brown/AFP/Getty Images
Megan Stalter is dressed as an Emmy, which is certainly a choice. The hot pants are slightly anachronistic and the gold paint is absolutely going to get itchy but at least it’s not boring. The US comedian and actor is up for outstanding supporting actress in a comedy series for Hacks. Paul W Downs, who does look boring, is up for three Emmys: he’s a supporting actor, writer and executive producer on Hacks.Photograph: Amy Sussman/Getty Images
Matty Matheson looks toque notch in a single-breasted suit jacket complete with a cummerbund and cat-eye sunglasses. The Canadian chef is also executive producer of The Bear, which is nominated for eight Emmys including outstanding comedy series. Photograph: Christopher Polk/Deadline/Getty Images
The Pitt star Shabana Azeez (foreground), in a gold hand-beaded gown by Sophie Couture, with The Bear’s Abby Elliott in a blush pink numberfrom British brand Erdem’s 2026 resort collection – a look Sydney Sweeny wore in 2025.Photograph: David Swanson/EPA
Selena Gomez is also making a nod to the Emmys statuette, albeit in a more subtle way than Megan Stalter. Only Murders in the Building, a series in which she’s the star and executive producer, is up for five awards including outstanding comedy series.Photograph: Gilbert Flores/Variety/Getty Images
It’s weird to see Roddy Ho looking hot, but that fault lies with Australian actor Christopher Chung. Slow Horses is nominated for nine Emmys, including for outstanding drama series.Photograph: Matt Baron/BEI/Shutterstock
Red is a recurring theme on the blue carpet tonight. Cailee Spaeny matches a red lip to her Miu Miu dress. Photograph: Gilbert Flores/Variety/Getty Images
Macaulay Culkin in an unbuttoned shirt and cream suit that really on vibes should be linen, evening event be damned.Photograph: Amy Sussman/Getty Images
Euphoria star Zendaya in a custom crystal Prada gown. She is up for outstanding lead actress in a drama series for her portrayal of Rue in the final series of the HBO show.Photograph: Daniel Cole/Reuters
Might it be Noah Wyle’s year again? The Pitt star looks smart this year – though last year he did wear a one-of-a-kind custom navy tuxedo made by a medical scrubs company.Photograph: Monica Schipper/Getty Images
Odessa A’zion looks positively witchy in this vintage black velvet-panelled Jean Paul Gaultier two-piece, but with that lengthy fringing we are hoping she keeps a safe distance from pedestal fans and propellers. Photograph: Michael Buckner/Variety/Getty Images
Scottish actor Richard Gadd is nominated for best supporting actor in a limited series or anthology for HBO’s Half Man. He matches the peacock blue carpet with a suit by Dunhill designed by Simon Holloway.Photograph: Jill Connelly/EPA
The Pitt star Fiona Dourif, nominated for outstanding supporting actress in a drama series, looking like an expensive and beautiful curtain.Photograph: Amy Sussman/Getty Images
First-time nominee Chase Infiniti looks like a poisonous fish in a mermaid-style Louis Vuitton gown. She’s up for outstanding lead actress in a drama series for The Testaments.Photograph: Monica Schipper/Getty Images
The final season of The Late Show may have wrapped up in May but Stephen Colbert is all smiles. The final season is up for nine Emmys including outstanding variety series.Photograph: NBC/Getty Images
Rufus Sewell will to horse girls of a certain age always be Count Ademar from A Knight’s Tale but tonight he’s up for outstanding lead actor in a drama series for his role as Hal Wyler in The Diplomat.Photograph: Matt Baron/BEI/Shutterstock
Charles Melton is mogging – or potentially jawmaxxing? – in a classic black tuxedo. The US actor and former model is nominated for outstanding supporting actor in a limited series or anthology for Netflix’s Beef.Photograph: Kevin Mazur/Getty Images
In true Deborah Vance style, Jean Smart, winner of outstanding lead actress in a comedy series, is wearing a plunging V-neck metallic dress that reaches the floor.Photograph: Richard Shotwell/AP
Backless dresses are dominating the red (blue) carpet, and no one does it better than Keri Russell – wearing a bold backless leather halter gown from Khaite. Photograph: Michael Buckner/Variety/Getty Images
Shailene Woodley is wearing pants made out of popcorn ceiling, a plunging bodysuit, and what can only be described as calf-pulling gloves. She’s nominated for outstanding guest actress in a drama series for Paradise.Photograph: Jill Connelly/EPA
Allison Janney is a winner for her role as President Grace Penn in The Diplomat. It’s lovely to briefly imagine a world in which presidential attire includes a lilac feather boa. Photograph: Amy Sussman/Getty Images
Charlie Hunnam is nominated for outstanding lead actor in a limited or anthology series for his role in the Ryan Murphy joint Monster: The Ed Gein story, as the titular serial killer Ed Gein.Photograph: NBC/Getty Images
Looking distinctly more scrubbed up than his Slow Horses character Jackson Lamb, Gary Oldman swaps his lumpy beige trench for a smart double-breasted suit jacket with contrast black peak lapels. Oldman is up for an Emmy for best lead actor in a drama series. Photograph: Matt Baron/BEI/Shutterstock
Elle Fanning looks very like Nicole Kidman in a mint green bias-cut slip dress, with a train made of fringing. She’s nominated for outstanding lead actress in a comedy series for Apple TV’s Margo’s Got Money Troubles, which is up for a total of eight entries including outstanding comedy series.Photograph: Richard Shotwell/AP
Hannah Einbinder is wearing a simple look plucked straight from Calvin Klein’s latest show at New York fashion week. Einbinder has been nominated five times for outstanding supporting actress in a comedy series in her role in Hacks and is looking to take home a second win.Photograph: Matt Baron/BEI/Shutterstock
If Aimee Carrero were a chip, she’d be a packet of Ruffles. The Dominican Republic-born actor wears a black bralette two-piece that goes big on texture, plus a sky-high skirt split – with mandatory leg pop. The actor stars in Your Friends & Neighbors, which is nominated for best drama series.Photograph: Daniel Cole/Reuters
Florence Pugh in a pastel Barbie dream dress with a slightly confusing off-the-shoulder train situation and the slightly spiky up-do of a mean girl at the prom in an early 2000s movie. It’s excellent.Photograph: NBC/Getty Images
Australian actor Sarah Snook in a column dress in the perfect shade of cream, and matching necklace and cuffs that are expensive and delicate and very unfortunately reminiscent of fingerless fishnet gloves. She is nominated for outstanding lead actress in a limited or anthology series for All Her Fault.Photograph: Daniel Cole/Reuters
Nicole Kidman, still with the tousled hair of her Practical Magic 2 press junket, has gone for a tea-length gown, which feels moderately scandalous. Photograph: Christopher Polk/Deadline/Getty Images
Ayo Edebiri in a periwinkle blue dress with a red bow performing double-duty as a bustle in the back. She’s up for outstanding lead actress in a comedy series for The Bear, one of the Hulu show’s eight nominations. Photograph: Richard Shotwell/AP
The internet’s boyfriend and Saturday Night Live cast member Marcello Hernández, with a take on slutty little glasses that unfortunately doesn’t quite land – sunglasses just aren’t the same. SNL is up for 11 awards. Photograph: Mark J Terrill/AP
He might have one of the best takes on red delicious apples but tonight Sterling K Brown, in a royal blue tuxe, is nominated for outstanding lead actor in a drama series for Paradise.Photograph: Gilbert Flores/Variety/Getty Images
A very spray-tanned Claire Danes in a structural silver gown with slightly confusing construction. She’s nominated for outstanding actress in a limited or anthology series for The Beast in Me, of which she’s also an executive producer. The Netflix show is up for nine awards including outstanding limited or anthology series.Photograph: Richard Shotwell/AP
Widow’s Bay star Dale Dickey, who is nominated for outstanding supporting actress in a comedy series, opts for a classic black and gold combo.Photograph: Gilbert Flores/Variety/Getty Images
Oscar Isaac, nominated for both an acting and producing Emmy for Beef, wears a white double-breasted suit jacket with a matching cummerbund by Celine.Photograph: Chelsea Lauren/Shutterstock
